about: Follow-up 1 to STORY-009. The exact failure wordings pattern_matcher.py will learn, fixed on 2026-09-24 BEFORE any new held-out pilot case was written, based on how common platforms word these errors rather than on any test case. Only these wordings may be added; a rule added or changed after the follow-up pilot run does not count toward a pass.
pass_rule: Unchanged from pilot/expected.json: overall error rate <= 5% and every case within 3600 s. The user chose the 5% limit alone (no extra zero-error rule on the new held-out cases).
